name: Doctor Strange

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.
abilityDetails.Coldsnap: Ani soğuk hasarı verir ve düşmanın Kaçış yeteneğini kapatır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Fateseal: Uygulandığında hedefteki tüm buff'ları Nullify eder ve aktifken yenilerinin kazanılmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Neutralize: Buff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

howToPlay: Doctor Strange için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mystic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Well of Unseen Worlds
At the start of each fight, grant the Opponent [1 - 3] (rounded down) indefinite Placebo Buffs and then inflict a Fate Seal Passive for 3 seconds.
When Doctor Strange gains an Arcane Font, he has a [10 - 30]% chance to gain another. This can trigger itself, but is not affected by Ability Accuracy.
Before the Opponent would be Knocked Out, inflict a 125% Neutralize Passive for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Master of the Mystic Arts
content: Earth's Sorcerer Supreme, Doctor Stephen Strange has 0% Combat Power Rate, but he generates 3.5% of his Max Power per second.
As an Attacker, Doctor Strange Passively gains 12% of his Max Power each time a Buff on the Opponent is Nullified or expires naturally. This replaces the Mystic Dispersion Mastery.

abilitySections.title: Arcane Arsenal - Always Active
content: Channeling defensive wards, Doctor Strange Passively Regenerates 60% of the damage taken from Blocked hits, or 80% from a Well-Timed Block.
Slinging offensive cantrips, all of Doctor Strange's attacks deal Energy Damage and bursts of [2,542] Energy Damage.
Prepared with counterspells, after the Opponent gains a Buff, Doctor Strange has a 60% chance to Nullify their most recent Buff.

abilitySections.title: Arcane Fonts - Max: 100
content: When any Buff on the Opponent is Nullified, Doctor Strange gains an Arcane Font, each increasing the potency of his personal bursts of Energy Damage by 3%.
While charging or performing a Heavy Attack, double tap Block to consume 1 Bar of Power to gain 3 Arcane Fonts, once per Heavy.

abilitySections.title: Vishanti Blessings
content: Doctor Stephen Strange invokes three Vishanti Blessings to aid him in battle, each lasting 20 seconds and cycling in sequential order. Blessings are paused while Doctor Strange is performing a Heavy or Special Attack.
Oshtur's Refuge: grants 40% increased Regeneration potency. During the Opponent's Special Attacks, this bonus is doubled and this Blessing is paused.
Agamotto's Insight: grants +[1,779.4] Attack Rating. During Doctor Strange's Special Attack 1, this bonus is doubled.
Hoggoth's Wisdom: grants 100% increased Ability Accuracy. During Doctor Strange's Special Attack 2, he gains an additional Arcane Font when an Opponent's Buff is Nullified.

abilitySections.title: Time Weaving - Heavy Attack
content: Charging a Heavy Attack after landing any non-Combo-Ending Attack inflicts a Stun Passive for 0.3 seconds.
While charging a Heavy Attack, personal effects on the Opponent are paused. Doctor Strange's Heavy Attack can be charged for an extended duration.
After charging for 0.5 seconds, Doctor Strange increases the expiry rate of his Vishanti Blessings by 1,200% for as long as he charges his Heavy Attack.

abilitySections.title: Sorcerer Supreme's Spells - Heavy and Special Attacks
content: The final hit of Doctor Strange's Heavy Attack, and the final 3 hits of his Special Attacks 1 and 2 trigger effects based on the current Vishanti Blessing.
Under Oshtur's Refuge, inflict a 30% Wither Passive for 30 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
With Agamotto's Insight, deal an additional burst of [2,542] Energy Damage.
Through Hoggoth's Wisdom, grant the Opponent a Placebo Buff for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Elemental Wizardry
content: On the first hit, the Winds of Watoomb inflict a Coldsnap Debuff dealing [4,575.6] Energy Damage over 2.5 seconds.
On the next 3 hits, the Flames of Faltine inflict Incinerate Debuffs each dealing [1,525.2] Energy Damage over 0.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Eldritch Incantation
content: The first 3 hits lash with an Eldritch Whip, each granting the Opponent a Placebo Buff for 10 seconds.
After landing the final hit, 3 Buffs on the Opponent each have a 50% chance to be Nullified.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Rush Hour
content: Refresh the current Vishanti Blessing and inflict a Fate Seal Passive for 15 seconds.
While this Fate Seal is active, when the Opponent is prevented from gaining a Buff due to Fate Seal or Immunity, Doctor Strange gains an Arcane Font.
